verdicts.reason: In both, the cream circle has split off from the bottle and sits clipped in the bottom-left corner, so the orange can now disappears into the orange background. In A, the headline is far too small for the canvas, the NEW badge floats alone in the top-right corner away from everything else, and the copy is scattered with big dead gaps between pieces. B has a much stronger headline hierarchy. However, its subhead is nearly as big as the headline, with an orphaned 'now.', and the NEW badge and Try It button are jammed against the right edge, beside the text column rather than under it.
